title: New state cursive-instruction laws: multi-year stretch vs 2026 alone

source.name: State legislation tracking on cursive handwriting mandates
source.publisher: Compiled from state education department / legislature records

notes: Six states added a cursive requirement over the 2016-2019 stretch (14 to 20 states). In 2026 alone, at least four more joined -- Florida, Pennsylvania, New Jersey and Idaho -- with reporting citing concern over AI-generated schoolwork as part of the renewed push, alongside the older cognitive-development and historical-document-literacy arguments.
